# Lucky Loki

> AI face swap app for photos and short video clips, available for iPhone and Android.
> Application services are provided by Griffonix Inc. Coiner.Cab Corp. is the creator and a principal rightsholder or licensor.

Lucky Loki lets a user save source face images, choose a target photo or short video, and generate a face-swapped result. Creating face swaps requires Lucky Loki Pro. Users can start with a free trial; a paid quarterly subscription begins automatically when the trial ends unless cancelled beforehand. The applicable price and final purchase terms are shown by the App Store or Google Play before confirmation.

Saved source face images remain available until the user removes them in the app. Target content and generated results are processed temporarily for creation and delivery, not as long-term storage. User content is not used to train, fine-tune, improve, or evaluate AI models.

Users may use output for lawful personal or commercial purposes if they have all required content and likeness rights and any paid feature used is covered by an active entitlement. Output is synthetic media. Users are responsible for legal and platform disclosure requirements that apply to their use.
